SCHEDULE OF RESIDENT FEES

Crestline Residential Partners LLC
340 Marlowe Court, City of Ashgrove
In effect from January 1, 2027

This schedule lists the charges that apply to a resident of 340 Marlowe Court. It is the schedule named in section 5.1 of the Residential Lease Agreement, and a charge listed here is collected in the same way as rent.

A. MOVING IN

A.1 Application and screening, per adult applicant: $75.

A.2 Key and fob issue, per set: $40.

A.3 Elevator reservation for a move-in, per booking: $100, refunded if the booking is cancelled at least two days ahead.

A.4 Reletting of the mailbox lock, if the resident asks for it: $25.

B. PAYING RENT

B.1 Late charge, added once when rent is received after the fifth day of the month: $95.

B.2 Returned payment, per returned item: $50.

B.3 Payment by card through the online portal, per transaction: 2.9 percent of the amount paid.

B.4 A paper receipt mailed to the resident on request, per receipt: no charge.

C. ENDING THE LEASE BEFORE THE TERM ENDS

C.1 A resident who ends the lease before the last day of the term shall pay a lease break administration fee of three (3) months rent, due on the day the resident returns possession, and this fee is in addition to rent owed through the end of the notice period.

C.2 The lease break administration fee is not reduced if the landlord re-lets the premises during the notice period or afterwards.

C.3 Transfer of the lease to another occupant, per transfer: $350.

C.4 Early return of keys without the notice the lease requires, per occurrence: one month of rent.

D. LIVING IN THE BUILDING

D.1 Second parking space, per month: $85.

D.2 Basement storage locker, per month: $45.

D.3 Lockout after the building office has closed, per call-out: $120.

D.4 Replacement of a lost fob, per fob: $65.

D.5 Removal of an item left in a common hallway, per item: $30.

E. MOVING OUT

E.1 Cleaning of the premises if the resident leaves it unclean, charged at the contractor's invoice with no markup.

E.2 Replacement of a missing smoke alarm, per alarm: $45.

E.3 Repainting, charged only where a wall needs repainting beyond ordinary wear, at the contractor's invoice with no markup.

E.4 Forced-place insurance bought under section 15.4 of the lease, per month: $28.

F. HOW THIS SCHEDULE CHANGES

F.1 This schedule may be revised once in any twelve month period, on thirty days written notice to each resident.

F.2 A revised schedule applies to events that happen after the notice period ends.

F.3 The current schedule is posted in the building office and is given to each resident with the lease.
